summary.name: Tuleap
summary.one_liner: Tuleap is a libre suite for planning, tracking, coding and collaborating on software projects, as described in the awesome-selfhosted listing.
use_cases: plan and track software development projects
collaborate on code with a development team
run an open source application lifecycle management setup
summary.what_it_does: The page is only a login screen for tuleap.net, so it shows no feature details itself. It offers login with a local account, Google, Microsoft, and MyEnalean, plus account creation and a password reset link. Per the awesome-selfhosted listing, Tuleap is a libre suite to plan, track, code and collaborate on software projects, and it is listed under Project Management with source code under GPL-2.0 and written in PHP. The page links to documentation, release notes and an API, but their contents were not available here.
notable: Distributed under GPL-2.0 and written in PHP, per the awesome-selfhosted listing
Git repository hosting integrated with project planning and tracking
Login supports Google, Microsoft and MyEnalean accounts
caveats: The page is only a login screen, so features were taken from the awesome-selfhosted listing and not verified on the page
The page warns that the browser is outdated and may cause issues
